title: Vampire Vape Iced Frappe Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Embrace the invigorating taste of our Iced Frappe e-liquid, a delightful blend that captures the essence of your favourite frosty coffeehouse treat. Savour the smooth, velvety notes of freshly brewed coffee, chilled, then perfectly complemented by a dash of sweet, silky cream to create an authentic and luxurious flavour profile. Stay refreshed with this cool and sophisticated concoction, expertly designed to provide a satisfying and well-rounded vaping experience. The harmonious blend of bold coffee flavours and delicate sweetness will keep you coming back for more, making Iced Frappe your go-to choice for a chilled-out, revitalizing vape session. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
